mapper.select:
select aaa.* from (
UNION ALL
) aaa left join SYS_DATADICT_LIST sdl on aaa.entrustStatus=sdl.ITEM_CODE and sdl.DICT_CODE='ENTRUST_STATUS' left join SYS_DATADICT_LIST dictps on aaa.PS=dictps.ITEM_CODE and dictps.DICT_CODE='PS' left join SYS_DATADICT_LIST dictpriceModel on aaa.priceModel=dictpriceModel.ITEM_CODE and dictpriceModel.DICT_CODE='PRICE_MODEL'
order by sdl.ORDER_NO, aaa.entrustId DESC

if.test: vagueQuery != null and vagueQuery != '' and vagueQuery !='有效'
if.where: aaa.entrustId || '|' || sdl.ITEM_VALUE || '|' || aaa.invManagerId || '|' || aaa.portfolioId || '|' || aaa.portfolioName || '|' || aaa.finprodMarketId || '|' || aaa.finprodAbbr || '|' || aaa.secType1 || '|' || dictps.ITEM_VALUE || '|' || aaa.shareNum || '|' || dictpriceModel.ITEM_VALUE || '|' || aaa.unitPrice || '|' || aaa.allPrice || '|' || aaa.matureYield || '|' || aaa.exerYield || '|T+' || aaa.SETTLE_SPREED || '|' || TO_CHAR(aaa.VDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') || '|' || TO_CHAR(aaa.MDATE, 'yyyy-MM-dd') || '|' || aaa.finishAmt || '|' || aaa.transactioncom || '|' || aaa.REMARK || '|' || aaa.counterId || '|' || aaa.parentPortfolioId like '%' || #{vagueQuery} || '%'

mapper.select:
select distinct t2.ITEM_CODE ITEM_CODE from FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN t1 inner join sys_datadict_list t2 on t2.DICT_CODE = 'EXEC_MODE' and t1.EXERCISE_TYPE = t2.ITEM_CODE where 1 = 1
AND t1.FINPROD_ID = #{secId}

SELECT Max(TRADE_DATE) TRADE_DATE FROM( SELECT Max(TRADE_DATE) TRADE_DATE FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{secId} AND TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND (IS_CANCEL='N' or IS_CANCEL IS NULL) UNION ALL SELECT Max(TRADE_DATE) TRADE_DATE FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{secId} )

SELECT Min(TRADE_DATE) TRADE_DATE FROM( SELECT Max(TRADE_DATE) TRADE_DATE FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{secId} AND TRADE_STATUS = '01' AND (IS_CANCEL='N' or IS_CANCEL IS NULL) UNION ALL SELECT Min(TRADE_DATE) TRADE_DATE FROM WFL_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{secId} )

select T1.ENTRUST_ID entrustId, T1.ENTRUST_STATUS entrustStatus, T8.REAL_NAME invManagerId, T1.PORTFOLIO_ID portfolioId, T2.PORTFOLIO_NAME portfolioName, T1.FINPROD_ID finprodId, T3.FINPROD_MARKET_ID finprodMarketId, T3.FINPROD_ABBR finprodAbbr, T4.TYPE_9 secType1, T1.PS as ps, NVL(T1.ENTRUST_NUM,0) / 100 shareNum, T1.PRICE_MODEL priceModel, T1.PRICE unitPrice, T7.FULL_PRICE allPrice, T7.MATURE_YIELD*100 matureYield, T7.EXER_YIELD*100 exerYield, T7.SETTLE_SPREED as settleSpreed, T1.vdate etrDate, T1.REMARK as remark ,T1.INV_AIM as businessModel from ETR_ENTRUST T1 INNER JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO T2 ON T1.PORTFOLIO_ID = T2.PORTFOLIO_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT T3 ON T1.FINPROD_ID = T3.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ENTRUST_ID, SUM( FINISH_AMT) as FINISH_AMT FROM ETR_FINISH_STATUS GROUP BY ENTRUST_ID) T5 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID = T5.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN ETR_ENTRUST_ADD T7 ON T1.ENTRUST_ID = T7.ENTRUST_ID LEFT JOIN SYS_USER T8 ON T1.INV_MANAGER_ID = T8.USER_NAME LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE T4 ON T4.FINPROD_ID = T1.FINPROD_ID where 1=1
AND T1.ENTRUST_ID = #{entrustId}
